'''Vyn Rolado''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] officer stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. He was responsible for taming the alpha [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]].
